definition.name: Invoice_Assurance_Orchestrator_v1
definition.description: Fetches invoices from Outlook and a OneDrive 'Raw' folder every 30 minutes, or accepts a manually uploaded invoice file. Prevents duplicate processing by maintaining a log in OneDrive. Sequentially calls AP01 to AP08 operators on the retrieved batch with robust error handling. Aggregates any critical issues across the batch into a single immediate alert email to the authenticated user's Outlook account. Unconditionally saves results to OneDrive, and then dispatches summary emails containing status and error information.

envs.name: MICROSOFT_ONEDRIVE_TOKEN
envs.description: Authentication token for Microsoft OneDrive, required by the AP03, AP05, AP06, and AP08 subworkflows for reference data like DOA Matrix, to save final results, and to fetch raw invoices/maintain processed logs.

envs.name: MICROSOFT_OUTLOOK_TOKEN
envs.description: Authentication token for Microsoft Outlook, required to fetch invoices, send immediate problem alerts to the integrated user, and send summary or critical alert emails.

steps.name: Fetch or Receive Invoices
steps.description: Uses the manually uploaded invoice if provided, otherwise fetches recent invoice attachments from Outlook and raw invoice files from OneDrive. Maintains a processing log to prevent duplicates. Automatically generates a unique Case ID for the batch and handles errors by saving a status dictionary to user_inputs.
steps.agent_prompt: Generate a unique Case ID (e.g., 'CASE-YYYYMMDD-XXXX') at the beginning of the execution. Check if 'invoice_file' is provided in user_inputs. If so, use its local file path. If not, fetch invoice files from TWO sources: 1) Use the Microsoft Outlook API to fetch the 10 most recent emails containing invoice attachments and download them. 2) Use the Microsoft OneDrive API to list and download files from the folder path 'AP-Invoice-Assurance/Reference/Raw' (without 'MyFile/' prefix). To prevent processing duplicates, read a log file from OneDrive at 'AP-Invoice-Assurance/Reference/processed_log.txt' (create if it doesn't exist), filter out files you have already processed, append the new filenames/identifiers to the log, and upload the updated log back to OneDrive. Wrap all execution in a try-except block. Persist your output by saving a dictionary containing 'status' ('success' or 'error'), 'error_message' (if any), 'file_paths' (only new ones), and the generated 'case_id' into `user_inputs['fetch_invoices_output']`.

import os import json import uuid import sys import httpx import asyncio import aiofiles from datetime import datetime from IPython.display import HTML, display async def step_fetch_invoices_implementation(): step_id = "fetch_invoices" # 1. Generate unique Case ID step_fetch_invoices_case_id = f"CASE-{datetime.now().strftime('%Y%m%d')}-{uuid.uuid4().hex[:4].upper()}" # Initialize implementation state step_fetch_invoices_file_paths = [] step_fetch_invoices_newly_processed = [] step_fetch_invoices_output = { "status": "success", "error_message": None, "file_paths": [], "case_id": step_fetch_invoices_case_id } # Log for UI summary step_fetch_invoices_source_info = [] try: # Secrets step_fetch_invoices_outlook_token = os.environ.get("MICROSOFT_OUTLOOK_TOKEN") step_fetch_invoices_onedrive_token = os.environ.get("MICROSOFT_ONEDRIVE_TOKEN") # Check for manual input manual_file = user_inputs.get("invoice_file") if manual_file: # If manual file is provided, use it directly as per agent_prompt step_fetch_invoices_file_paths.append(manual_file) step_fetch_invoices_source_info.append({ "name": os.path.basename(manual_file), "source": "Manual Upload", "status": "Success" }) else: # Logic for automated fetching async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=60.0) as client: # 2. Duplicate Check: Read log from OneDrive processed_log_path = "AP-Invoice-Assurance/Reference/processed_log.txt" processed_log_content = "" processed_files_set = set() od_headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {step_fetch_invoices_onedrive_token}"} log_get_url = f"https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/me/drive/root:/{processed_log_path}:/content" log_resp = await client.get(log_get_url, headers=od_headers) if log_resp.status_code == 200: processed_log_content = log_resp.text processed_files_set = set(line.strip() for line in processed_log_content.splitlines() if line.strip()) # Sources logic fetch_tasks = [] # Source 1: Outlook if step_fetch_invoices_outlook_token: async def fetch_outlook(): outlook_headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {step_fetch_invoices_outlook_token}"} # Top 10 recent emails with attachments url = "https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/me/messages?$filter=hasAttachments eq true&$top=10&$orderby=receivedDateTime desc" resp = await client.get(url, headers=outlook_headers) if resp.status_code == 200: messages = resp.json().get("value", []) for msg in messages: att_url = f"https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/me/messages/{msg['id']}/attachments" att_resp = await client.get(att_url, headers=outlook_headers) if att_resp.status_code == 200: attachments = att_resp.json().get("value", []) for att in attachments: name = att.get("name") # Deduplicate check if name and name not in processed_files_set and att.get("@odata.type") == "#microsoft.graph.fileAttachment": # Download attachment dl_url = f"https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/me/messages/{msg['id']}/attachments/{att['id']}/$value" dl_resp = await client.get(dl_url, headers=outlook_headers) if dl_resp.status_code == 200: local_path = f"/tmp/outlook_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:6]}_{name}" async with aiofiles.open(local_path, mode="wb") as f: await f.write(dl_resp.content) step_fetch_invoices_file_paths.append(local_path) step_fetch_invoices_newly_processed.append(name) step_fetch_invoices_source_info.append({"name": name, "source": "Outlook", "status": "Fetched"}) fetch_tasks.append(fetch_outlook()) # Source 2: OneDrive if step_fetch_invoices_onedrive_token: async def fetch_onedrive(): raw_folder = "AP-Invoice-Assurance/Reference/Raw" url = f"https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/me/drive/root:/{raw_folder}:/children" resp = await client.get(url, headers=od_headers) if resp.status_code == 200: items = resp.json().get("value", []) for item in items: if "file" in item: name = item.get("name") if name and name not in processed_files_set: dl_url = item.get("@microsoft.graph.downloadUrl") dl_resp = await client.get(dl_url) if dl_resp.status_code == 200: local_path = f"/tmp/onedrive_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:6]}_{name}" async with aiofiles.open(local_path, mode="wb") as f: await f.write(dl_resp.content) step_fetch_invoices_file_paths.append(local_path) step_fetch_invoices_newly_processed.append(name) step_fetch_invoices_source_info.append({"name": name, "source": "OneDrive", "status": "Fetched"}) fetch_tasks.append(fetch_onedrive()) await asyncio.gather(*fetch_tasks) # 3. Update log in OneDrive if step_fetch_invoices_newly_processed: all_processed = list(processed_files_set) + step_fetch_invoices_newly_processed updated_content = "\n".join(all_processed) log_put_url = f"https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/me/drive/root:/{processed_log_path}:/content" await client.put(log_put_url, headers=od_headers, content=updated_content) except Exception as e: step_fetch_invoices_output["status"] = "error" step_fetch_invoices_output["error_message"] = str(e) print(f"Error in fetch_invoices: {e}", file=sys.stderr) # Persist outputs step_fetch_invoices_output["file_paths"] = step_fetch_invoices_file_paths user_inputs["fetch_invoices_output"] = step_fetch_invoices_output # Stdout trace trace_data = { "case_id": step_fetch_invoices_case_id, "files_count": len(step_fetch_invoices_file_paths), "status": step_fetch_invoices_output["status"], "error": step_fetch_invoices_output["error_message"] } print(json.dumps(trace_data, indent=2)) # HTML Output if step_fetch_invoices_output["status"] == "error": html = f"""

Invoice Retrieval Failed

An error occurred while fetching invoices for {step_fetch_invoices_case_id}.

{step_fetch_invoices_output['error_message']}
""" elif not step_fetch_invoices_file_paths: html = f"""

No New Invoices

Case ID: {step_fetch_invoices_case_id}

No unprocessed invoices were found in Outlook or OneDrive.

Idle
""" else: rows = "" for info in step_fetch_invoices_source_info: rows += f""" {info['name']} {info['source']} {info['status']} """ html = f"""

Invoice Retrieval Complete

Case ID: {step_fetch_invoices_case_id}

Successfully retrieved {len(step_fetch_invoices_file_paths)} invoice(s) for processing.

{rows}
File Name Source Status
""" display(HTML(html)) # Execute step await step_fetch_invoices_implementation()

steps.name: Call AP01 Invoice Extraction Subworkflow
steps.description: Calls the AP01 Invoice Extraction Operator to process the retrieved batch of invoices. Checks for upstream errors and handles internal exceptions safely. Evaluates critical extraction failures.

subworkflow_call.input_mapping_agent_prompt: Check `user_inputs.get('fetch_invoices_output', {})` for 'status' == 'error'. If true, record an error status in `user_inputs['ap01_in_output']` and skip mapping. Otherwise, create a Python dict `_subworkflow_inputs_call_ap01_subworkflow` mapping 'case_id' (from `user_inputs['fetch_invoices_output']['case_id']`) and 'invoice_file' (from file_paths in fetch_invoices_output). Wrap in try-except and record status to `user_inputs['ap01_in_output']`.
subworkflow_call.output_mapping_agent_prompt: Check for previous errors in user_inputs. If none, extract batch results from `_subworkflow_outputs_call_ap01_subworkflow`. Evaluate for critical issues (e.g., extraction failure or empty results). If a critical issue is detected, save 'status': 'error' and an 'error_message' detailing the failure. Otherwise, save the extraction results and 'status': 'success' into `user_inputs['ap01_out_output']` to persist.

import json import sys from IPython.display import HTML, display async def step_call_ap01_subworkflow_output_mapping_implementation_v3(): """ Implements the output mapping for AP01 Invoice Extraction. Evaluates subworkflow results for critical extraction failures and persists the state to user_inputs['ap01_out_output']. """ step_id = "call_ap01_subworkflow" persistence_key = "ap01_out_output" # Initialize implementation output for persistence # Defaulting to success, but logic below will evaluate for critical issues step_call_ap01_final_output = { "status": "success", "error_message": None, "extraction_results": [], "case_id": None } try: # 1. Check for previous errors in user_inputs fetch_output = user_inputs.get('fetch_invoices_output', {}) input_mapping_output = user_inputs.get('ap01_in_output', {}) step_call_ap01_final_output["case_id"] = fetch_output.get("case_id") upstream_failure = None if fetch_output.get('status') == 'error': upstream_failure = f"Upstream error in fetch_invoices: {fetch_output.get('error_message')}" elif input_mapping_output.get('status') == 'error': upstream_failure = f"Upstream error in input mapping: {input_mapping_output.get('error_message')}" if upstream_failure: step_call_ap01_final_output["status"] = "error" step_call_ap01_final_output["error_message"] = upstream_failure user_inputs[persistence_key] = step_call_ap01_final_output display(HTML(f"""

Extraction Results Halted

\n

Mapping was skipped because of a failure in a preceding step.

Upstream Error
""")) return # 2. Retrieve the injected subworkflow outputs # Pattern: _subworkflow_outputs_{stepId} sub_outputs = globals().get(f'_subworkflow_outputs_{step_id}', {}) activity_steps = sub_outputs.get('outputs', []) # 3. Aggregators and Error Tracking extracted_batch = [] critical_errors = [] # We look for steps that contain the structured extraction results. # We check both 'output' and 'results' keys across all activity runs. for activity in activity_steps: outputs_block = activity.get('outputs', {}) # Check for activity-level error first error_field = outputs_block.get('error') if error_field: critical_errors.append(f"Activity failed: {error_field}") continue for key in ['output', 'results']: val = outputs_block.get(key) if not val: continue try: parsed_data = None if isinstance(val, str): cleaned = val.strip() # Only parse if it looks like JSON if cleaned and (cleaned.startswith('{') or cleaned.startswith('[')): parsed_data = json.loads(cleaned) else: parsed_data = val if parsed_data: # Normalize into extracted_batch if isinstance(parsed_data, dict): # Ensure it's an extraction result by checking for known keys # (case_id, document_type, or extracted_header) if any(k in parsed_data for k in ['document_type', 'extracted_header', 'operator']): extracted_batch.append(parsed_data) elif isinstance(parsed_data, list): for item in parsed_data: if isinstance(item, dict) and any(k in item for k in ['document_type', 'extracted_header']): extracted_batch.append(item) except (json.JSONDecodeError, TypeError) as e: # Log but only treat as critical error if we find nothing at the end print(f"Non-critical parse error in activity {activity.get('stepId')}: {e}", file=sys.stderr) # 4. Evaluate for Critical Issues expected_count = len(fetch_output.get('file_paths', [])) # If the batch is completely empty and we expected files, that's critical. if expected_count > 0 and not extracted_batch: step_call_ap01_final_output["status"] = "error" step_call_ap01_final_output["error_message"] = f"Extraction failure: No valid data records were retrieved for {expected_count} expected files." # 5. Persist Results step_call_ap01_final_output["extraction_results"] = extracted_batch user_inputs[persistence_key] = step_call_ap01_final_output # 6. Stdout Debug Trace (JSON) print(json.dumps(step_call_ap01_final_output, indent=2, default=str)) # 7. HTML Output (Atmospheric Glass) if step_call_ap01_final_output["status"] == "error": html_content = f"""

Extraction Critical Failure

The subworkflow failed to produce valid extraction results for the batch.

{step_call_ap01_final_output['error_message']}
""" elif not extracted_batch: html_content = f"""

No Invoices Extracted

\n

Case ID: {step_call_ap01_final_output['case_id']}

The subworkflow completed but returned zero extraction records.

Idle
""" else: rows = "" for i, res in enumerate(extracted_batch): header = res.get('extracted_header', res) vendor = header.get('vendor_name', 'Unknown Vendor') inv_no = header.get('invoice_number', 'N/A') doc_type = res.get('document_type', 'INVOICE') currency = header.get('currency', '') amount = header.get('gross_amount', 0) try: formatted_total = f"{currency} {float(amount):,.2f}" if amount is not None else "N/A" except (ValueError, TypeError): formatted_total = f"{currency} {amount}" status_badge = "ag-badge-success" if doc_type == "INVOICE" else "ag-badge-warning" rows += f""" {i+1} {vendor} {inv_no} {formatted_total} {doc_type} """ html_content = f"""

Extraction Aggregation Complete

Consolidated {len(extracted_batch)} record(s) for Case {step_call_ap01_final_output['case_id']}.

{rows}
# Vendor Invoice # Total Amount Type
""" display(HTML(html_content)) except Exception as e: step_call_ap01_final_output["status"] = "error" step_call_ap01_final_output["error_message"] = f"Internal mapping exception: {str(e)}" user_inputs[persistence_key] = step_call_ap01_final_output print(f"Mapping Implementation Error: {e}", file=sys.stderr) display(HTML(f"""

Mapping Failure

An unexpected error occurred during subworkflow result processing.

{str(e)}
""")) # Execute the mapping implementation await step_call_ap01_subworkflow_output_mapping_implementation_v3()

steps.agent_prompt:
Use `call_ai_llm` to extract data from `user_inputs['invoice_file']` using strict Pydantic models for the AP01 v1 specification. 
Models must include: document_type (INVOICE, CREDIT_NOTE, DEBIT_NOTE, UNSUPPORTED_DOCUMENT, UNREADABLE_DOCUMENT), raw_text, extracted_header (vendor_name, vendor_number, invoice_number, invoice_date, po_number, currency, gross_amount, tax_code, tax_amount, bank_account), extracted_lines (description, material_number, po_item_number, quantity, uom, unit_price, line_amount, and field_confidences dict for each line), field_confidences (for header fields), and overall document confidence.
In your Python code after the LLM call:
1. Calculate the SHA-256 hash of the input file for `attachment_hash`. Set `attachment_path` to the input file path.
2. Identify missing header fields (where value is None) and add their names to `missing_fields`.
3. Build `findings` as a list of dicts: {"code": "...", "severity": "...", "message": "...", "evidence": []}.
4. Evaluate logic for execution_status, next_action, and findings:
- If document_type == 'UNREADABLE_DOCUMENT': add finding 'OCR_FAILED' (severity HIGH), set status to 'ERROR', next_action to 'Route to Technical-Error or Human-Review', human_review_required to True.
- Else if document_type == 'UNSUPPORTED_DOCUMENT': add finding 'NOT_AN_INVOICE' (severity MEDIUM), set status to 'REVIEW', next_action to 'Route to Human-Review', human_review_required to True.
- Else if any critical field (vendor_name or vendor_number, invoice_number, invoice_date, currency, gross_amount) has a confidence < 80: add finding 'LOW_CONFIDENCE_CRITICAL_FIELD' (severity MEDIUM), set status to 'REVIEW', next_action to 'Route to Human-Review', human_review_required to True.
- Else: set status to 'SUCCESS', next_action to 'Continue to AP02', human_review_required to False.
Construct the final payload with: case_id (from user_inputs), operator 'AP01_Invoice_Extraction', operator_version 'v1', execution_status, hard_block (False), findings, confidence, next_action, human_review_required, document_type, raw_text, attachment_path, attachment_hash, extracted_header, extracted_lines, field_confidences, and missing_fields. Perform AI LLM Extraction step_extract_data_ext = os.path.splitext(step_extract_data_file_path)[1].lower() step_extract_data_input_mode = "document" if step_extract_data_ext == ".pdf" else "image" step_extract_data_system_prompt = ( "You are an expert accounts payable extraction system (AP01 v1 Spec). Extract header fields (vendor_name, vendor_number, invoice_number, invoice_date, po_number, currency, gross_amount, tax_code, tax_amount, bank_account) and line items accurately.\n" "2. Classify the document: INVOICE, CREDIT_NOTE, DEBIT_NOTE, UNSUPPORTED_DOCUMENT, UNREADABLE_DOCUMENT.\n" "5. If unreadable or unsupported, set document_type accordingly." ) step_extract_data_llm_result = await call_ai_llm( system_prompt=step_extract_data_system_prompt, user_prompt=f"Extract data from this document for Case ID: {step_extract_data_case_id}", response_schema_pydantic_model=Step_Extract_Data_ExtractionResult, model="gemini-3.1-pro-preview", input_mode=step_extract_data_input_mode, media_local_path=step_extract_data_file_path, thinking_level="high" ) # 5. Post-Extraction Logic & Payload Construction step_extract_data_findings = [] step_extract_data_missing_fields = [] # Identify missing header fields (where value is None) step_extract_data_header_dict = step_extract_data_llm_result.extracted_header.dict() for field_name, value in step_extract_data_header_dict.items(): if value is None: step_extract_data_missing_fields.append(field_name) # Write a Python script to classify an invoice using an LLM and enforce routing logic via Python.

First, define a Pydantic model for the LLM output:
```python
from pydantic import BaseModel
from typing import Literal, List

class ClassificationResult(BaseModel):
    invoice_type: Literal["PO_INVOICE", "NON_PO_INVOICE", "SERVICE_INVOICE", "CREDIT_NOTE", "DEBIT_NOTE", "UNKNOWN"]
    classification_confidence: int
    classification_evidence: List[str]
    has_po_number: bool
```

Use `call_ai_llm` with the `ClassificationResult` schema to analyze `user_inputs["case_id"]`, `user_inputs["document_type"]`, `user_inputs["raw_text"]`, `user_inputs["extracted_header"]`, `user_inputs["extracted_lines"]`, and `user_inputs["field_confidences"]`. Provide these rules to the LLM:
1. Explicit invoice characteristics with a PO number normally mean PO_INVOICE.
2. A missing PO number is not automatically an error.
3. No PO number with expense, subscription, utility, rent, professional fee, or business-cost language may mean NON_PO_INVOICE.
4. Consulting, maintenance, labour, hourly work, service period, support, or professional-service language may mean SERVICE_INVOICE.
5. Explicit credit-note wording or a negative amount may mean CREDIT_NOTE.
6. Explicit debit-note wording may mean DEBIT_NOTE.
7. Prefer explicit wording over assumptions. Do not infer when evidence is insufficient. UNKNOWN requires human review.

Then, use Python to apply routing and status rules based on the LLM result:
- PO_INVOICE -> required_route: "PO_VALIDATION_AND_MATCHING"
- NON_PO_INVOICE -> required_route: "NON_PO_INFORMATION_REQUEST". Set required_missing_information = ["gl_code", "cost_centre", "business_justification", "approval"]
- SERVICE_INVOICE with PO (has_po_number=True) -> required_route: "PO_VALIDATION_AND_SERVICE_MATCHING"
- SERVICE_INVOICE without PO (has_po_number=False) -> required_route: "NON_PO_INFORMATION_REQUEST"
- CREDIT_NOTE -> required_route: "CREDIT_NOTE_REVIEW"
- DEBIT_NOTE -> required_route: "DEBIT_NOTE_REVIEW"
- UNKNOWN -> required_route: "HUMAN_REVIEW"

For status logic:
- If invoice_type == "UNKNOWN": execution_status = "REVIEW", human_review_required = True, next_action = "Route to Human-Review"
- Else (valid classification): execution_status = "SUCCESS", human_review_required = False, next_action = "Continue to AP03"

{

  "classification_evidence": llm_result.classification_evidence,

Process History DataFrames --- sd_sap_map = {'BELNR': 'belnr', 'LIFNR': 'vendor_number', 'XBLNR': 'invoice_number', 'BLDAT': 'invoice_date', 'WRBTR': 'amount', 'EBELN': 'po_number'} if not sd_df_sap.empty: sd_df_sap = sd_df_sap.rename(columns={k: v for k, v in sd_sap_map.items() if k in sd_df_sap.columns}) sd_df_sap['norm_inv'] = sd_df_sap['invoice_number'].apply(sd_norm_invoice_num) sd_df_sap['norm_vendor'] = sd_df_sap['vendor_number'].apply(sd_norm_string) sd_df_sap['norm_po'] = sd_df_sap['po_number'].apply(sd_norm_string) sd_df_sap['dt_date'] = sd_df_sap['invoice_date'].apply(sd_parse_date) sd_df_sap['flt_amount'] = sd_df_sap['amount'].apply(sd_parse_amount) if not sd_df_audit.empty: if 'case_id' in sd_df_audit.columns: sd_df_audit = sd_df_audit[sd_df_audit['case_id'] != str(sd_case_id)] if 'invoice_date' in sd_df_audit.columns: sd_df_audit['dt_date'] = sd_df_audit['invoice_date'].apply(sd_parse_date) if 'amount' in sd_df_audit.columns: sd_df_audit['flt_amount'] = sd_df_audit['amount'].apply(sd_parse_amount) # --- 6. Duplicate Detection Logic --- sd_matched_records = [] # 6.1 EXACT_DOCUMENT_DUPLICATE (Audit hash) if sd_attachment_hash and not sd_df_audit.empty and 'attachment_hash' in sd_df_audit.columns: sd_hash_matches = sd_df_audit[sd_df_audit['attachment_hash'] == str(sd_attachment_hash)] for _, row in sd_hash_matches.iterrows(): sd_rec = row.to_dict() sd_rec['match_reason'] = "EXACT_DOCUMENT_DUPLICATE" sd_matched_records.append(sd_rec) # 6.2 EXACT_DUPLICATE (SAP) if not sd_df_sap.empty and sd_curr_vendor_no and sd_curr_inv_no_norm: sd_exact_mask = (sd_df_sap['norm_vendor'] == sd_curr_vendor_no) & (sd_df_sap['norm_inv'] == sd_curr_inv_no_norm) sd_exact_matches = sd_df_sap[sd_exact_mask] for _, row in sd_exact_matches.iterrows(): sd_rec = row.to_dict() sd_rec['match_reason'] = "EXACT_DUPLICATE" sd_matched_records.append(sd_rec) # 6.3 POSSIBLE_DUPLICATE (SAP) if not sd_df_sap.empty and sd_curr_vendor_no and sd_curr_amount is not None: try: # Match Vendor, Match Amount, Different Inv Num sd_poss_mask = (sd_df_sap['norm_vendor'] == sd_curr_vendor_no) & \ (np.isclose(sd_df_sap['flt_amount'].fillna(-1), sd_curr_amount, atol=0.01)) & \ (sd_df_sap['norm_inv'] != sd_curr_inv_no_norm) # Plus PO match OR Date window sd_sub_mask = pd.Series(False, index=sd_df_sap.index) if sd_curr_po: sd_sub_mask |= (sd_df_sap['norm_po'] == sd_curr_po) if sd_curr_date: sd_date_diff = (sd_df_sap['dt_date'] - sd_curr_date).abs() sd_sub_mask |= (sd_date_diff <= timedelta(days=7)) if not sd_curr_po and not sd_curr_date: sd_poss_matches = sd_df_sap[sd_poss_mask] else: sd_poss_matches = sd_df_sap[sd_poss_mask & sd_sub_mask] for _, row in sd_poss_matches.iterrows(): if row.get('belnr') not in [m.get('belnr') for m in sd_matched_records if m.get('match_reason') == "EXACT_DUPLICATE"]: sd_rec = row.to_dict() sd_rec['match_reason'] = "POSSIBLE_DUPLICATE" sd_matched_records.append(sd_rec) except: pass # --- 7. Status Determination --- sd_exec_status = "SUCCESS" sd_hard_block = False sd_dup_status = "NO_DUPLICATE" sd_next_act = "Proceed with processing." sd_findings = [] if any(m['match_reason'].startswith("EXACT") for m in sd_matched_records): sd_exec_status, sd_hard_block, sd_dup_status = "BLOCK", True, "EXACT_DUPLICATE" sd_next_act = "Reject invoice as an exact duplicate." sd_findings.append("Identified exact match in historical records.") elif any(m['match_reason'] == "POSSIBLE_DUPLICATE" for m in sd_matched_records): sd_exec_status, sd_dup_status = "REVIEW", "POSSIBLE_DUPLICATE" sd_next_act = "Manual review required to verify probable duplicate." sd_findings.append("Identified possible duplicate based on vendor, amount, and date/PO parameters.") elif not sd_history_loaded: sd_dup_status = "INSUFFICIENT_HISTORY" sd_findings.append("No historical data available for cross-check.") else: sd_findings.append("No duplicates detected in historical records.") # --- 8. Build JSON Report --- sd_report = { "case_id": sd_case_id, "operator": "AP03_Duplicate_Detection", "operator_version": "v1", "execution_status": sd_exec_status, "hard_block": sd_hard_block, "findings": sd_findings, "next_action": sd_next_act, "human_review_required": (sd_exec_status != "SUCCESS"), "duplicate_status": sd_dup_status, "matched_records": sd_matched_records, "comparison_keys": { "normalized": {"vendor": sd_curr_vendor_no, "invoice_no": sd_curr_inv_no_norm, "amount": sd_curr_amount, "date": str(sd_curr_date.date()) if sd_curr_date else None} } } sd_out_path = 'ap03_duplicate_report.json' with open(sd_out_path, 'w') as f: json.dump(sd_report, f, indent=2, default=str) await upload_output_file(sd_out_path) # --- 9. Duplicate Detection Summary

{sd_exec_status} Verdict: {sd_dup_status}

Recommendation: {sd_next_act}

Audit Findings

    {"".join([f"
  • {f}
    • " for f in sd_findings])}
""" if sd_matched_records: sd_html += """

Conflicting Records

""" for m in sd_matched_records[:10]: sd_html += f"""""" sd_html += "
RefVendorInv #AmountType
{m.get('belnr') or m.get('case_id') or 'N/A'}{m.get('vendor_number', 'N/A')}{m.get('invoice_number', 'N/A')}{m.get('amount', 'N/A')}{m.get('match_reason')}
" sd_html += "

steps.agent_prompt:
You are implementing the AP04 Invoice Field and Date Validation Operator v1. Access inputs from `user_inputs`: case_id, invoice_type, invoice_number, vendor_number, vendor_name, invoice_date, posting_date, amount, currency, po_number, field_confidence_scores, business_locale, date_order.

Write a Python script to perform deterministic parsing, validation, and date calculations. DO NOT use an LLM or any external services for this logic.

Rules:
1. Preserve original raw values in a `raw_fields` dictionary in the output.
2. Amount parsing: Support standard and unusual formats (e.g., 535579.28, 53,431.20, 327845,70, 1,191,636.88). If parsing is successful but required unusual interpretation (like comma as decimal), append 'SUCCESSFUL_UNUSUAL_FORMAT_NORMALIZATION' to findings. If parsing fails entirely, append 'AMOUNT_PARSE_ERROR'.
3. Date parsing: Support YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS, YYYY-MM-DD, DD/MM/YYYY, Mon DD YYYY. Use `date_order` (e.g., 'DMY') to resolve slash-separated ambiguity. Append 'DATE_PARSE_ERROR' if unparseable.
4. Mandatory fields: invoice_number, (vendor_number OR vendor_name), invoice_date, amount, currency. Append 'MISSING_REQUIRED_FIELD' if any are missing.
5. PO Number is mandatory ONLY if `invoice_type == "PO_INVOICE"` (exact string match).
6. Date anomaly: If `posting_date < invoice_date`, calculate `date_difference_days = invoice_date - posting_date`. Append 'POSTING_DATE_BEFORE_DOCUMENT_DATE' to findings. Assign severity: 1-7 days = LOW, 8-30 days = MEDIUM, >30 days = HIGH.
7. Validation codes: Append 'CURRENCY_FORMAT_ERROR' or 'INVOICE_NUMBER_FORMAT_ERROR' to findings if they are malformed.
8. Execution Status: Set `execution_status` to "REVIEW" if there are missing fields, parse errors, format errors, or date anomalies. Set to "SUCCESS" only if mandatory fields are valid and no review issues exist. If SUCCESS, add 'FIELDS_VALID' to findings.
9. Output EXACTLY ONE valid JSON object with this exact structure:
{
  "case_id": "",
  "operator": "AP04_Invoice_Field_Date_Validation",
  "operator_version": "v1",
  "execution_status": "SUCCESS | REVIEW | ERROR",
  "hard_block": false,
  "findings": [],
  "confidence": 100,
  "next_action": "",
  "human_review_required": false,
  "normalized_fields": {
    "invoice_number": null, "vendor_number": null, "vendor_name": null,
    "invoice_date": null, "posting_date": null, "amount": null, "currency": null, "po_number": null
  },
  "raw_fields": {},
  "date_difference_days": null,
  "validation_results": []
}

Save the resulting JSON to a file named `validation_report.json` and print its contents.

steps.agent_prompt:
Write a Python script to validate AP compliance rules using pandas.
1. Download '/AP-Invoice-Assurance/Reference/LFA1_Vendor_Master.csv' and '/AP-Invoice-Assurance/Reference/EKKO_PO_Header.csv' from OneDrive using the Microsoft Graph API and `MICROSOFT_ONEDRIVE_TOKEN` environment variable.
2. Inputs available: `case_id`, `vendor_number`, `vendor_name`, `po_number`, `currency`, `invoice_bank_account`, `tax_code`.

Safely parse JSON inputs def safe_parse(val): if not val: return {} if isinstance(val, (dict, list)): return val try: return json.loads(val) except: return {} findings_data = safe_parse(user_inputs.get('findings', '')) field_confidence_data = safe_parse(user_inputs.get('field_confidence', '')) date_diff_data = safe_parse(user_inputs.get('date_difference', '')) validation_data = safe_parse(user_inputs.get('validation_results', '')) compliance_data = safe_parse(user_inputs.get('compliance_results', '')) matching_data = safe_parse(user_inputs.get('three_way_matching_results', '')) # Helper to extract codes from various structures def extract_codes(data): codes = set() if isinstance(data, dict): # Check for 'findings', 'errors', 'results' keys for key in ['findings', 'errors', 'results', 'codes']: if key in data and isinstance(data[key], list): for item in data[key]: if isinstance(item, str): codes.add(item) elif isinstance(item, dict) and 'code' in item: codes.add(item['code']) # Also check top level keys if they look like codes (heuristic) if 'code' in data: codes.add(data['code']) elif isinstance(data, list): for item in data: if isinstance(item, str): codes.add(item) elif isinstance(item, dict) and 'code' in item: codes.add(item['code']) return codes # Aggregate all finding codes all_codes = set() for d in [findings_data, field_confidence_data, validation_data, compliance_data, matching_data]: all_codes.update(extract_codes(d)) # Scoring mapping score_rules = { "VENDOR_PO_MISMATCH": 60, "PO_NOT_FOUND": 50, "CURRENCY_MISMATCH": 50, "INVOICE_EXCEEDS_RECEIVED_VALUE": 40, "PRICE_VARIANCE": 40, "QUANTITY_VARIANCE": 40, "MULTIPLE_PO_LINE_MATCHES": 40, "PO_LINE_NOT_FOUND": 40, "LOW_CONFIDENCE_CRITICAL_FIELD": 30, "DATE_PARSE_ERROR": 30, "SUCCESSFUL_UNUSUAL_FORMAT_NORMALIZATION": 5 } # Calculate base score and track components calculated_score = 0 score_components = [] for code, points in score_rules.items(): if code in all_codes: calculated_score += points score_components.append({"type": "FINDING_CODE", "id": code, "points": points}) # Date Difference Scoring # Expecting date_difference to have date_difference_days key or be the number itself days = 0 if isinstance(date_diff_data, dict): days = date_diff_data.get('date_difference_days', 0) elif isinstance(date_diff_data, (int, float)): days = date_diff_data date_points = 0 if days > 30: date_points = 30 elif days >= 8: date_points = 20 elif days >= 1: date_points = 10 if date_points > 0: calculated_score += date_points score_components.append({"type": "DATE_GAP", "id": f"GAP_{days}_DAYS", "points": date_points}) # Cap score at 100 final_score = min(calculated_score, 100) # Determine Risk Level and Status risk_level = "LOW" execution_status = "SUCCESS" next_action = "Proceed to Payment" if 10 <= final_score <= 29: risk_level = "MEDIUM" execution_status = "REVIEW" next_action = "Pending Specialist Review" elif 30 <= final_score <= 69: risk_level = "HIGH" execution_status = "REVIEW" next_action = "Requires Senior Review" elif final_score >= 70: risk_level = "CRITICAL" execution_status = "HOLD" next_action = "Case Placed on Hold" # Human review requirement human_review_required = execution_status in ["REVIEW", "HOLD"] # Final Payload result_payload = { **operator_meta, "execution_status": execution_status, "hard_block": False, "findings": list(all_codes), "risk_score": final_score, "risk_level": risk_level, "score_components": score_components, "next_action": next_action, "human_review_required": human_review_required, "confidence": 100 } # Output JSON for system print(json.dumps(result_payload, indent=2)) # Display HTML for user badge_class = { "LOW": "ag-badge-success", "MEDIUM": "ag-badge-warning", "HIGH": "ag-badge-error", "CRITICAL": "ag-badge-error" }.get(risk_level, "ag-badge-neutral") status_badge_class = { "SUCCESS": "ag-badge-success", "REVIEW": "ag-badge-warning", "HOLD": "ag-badge-error" }.get(execution_status, "ag-badge-neutral") components_html = "".join([ f"{comp['id']}{comp['type']}{comp['points']}" for comp in score_components ]) html_output = f"""

Risk Assessment Calculation

Case ID: {case_id}
Risk Level: {risk_level}
Status: {execution_status}
Total Score: {final_score}

Scoring Components

{components_html if score_components else ""}
Identifier Type Points
No risk findings detected.

Next Action: {next_action}

""" display(HTML(html_output)) # Save to persistent state for next step globals()['step_calculate_risk_score_results'] = result_payload # Also save to a local JSON file as requested by the prompt with open("deterministic_scoring_results.json", "w") as f: json.dump(result_payload, f) await step_calculate_risk_score_main()

steps.name: Evaluate Readiness and Approver
steps.description: Downloads reference files from OneDrive, evaluates the invoice against the DOA matrix and readiness rules using strictly Python logic, generates a summary via AI, and outputs the decision as a JSON file.
steps.agent_prompt:
1. Download `AP-Invoice-Assurance/Reference/DOA_Matrix.csv` and `AP-Invoice-Assurance/Reference/SKA1_GL_MASTER.csv` from OneDrive using the Microsoft OneDrive REST API and the token provided in the `MICROSOFT_ONEDRIVE_TOKEN` environment variable.
2. Read both CSV files using pandas.
3. Implement GL & Cost Centre Validation in Python: Validate `gl_code` against SKA1_GL_MASTER and ensure `cost_centre` is allowed for that GL. If invalid, note configuration error for later steps.
4. Implement Approver Selection in Python: Filter DOA_Matrix by exact `cost_centre`. Convert amounts to numeric. Select row where `invoice_amount` fits the range. If decimal gaps exist, select row with the highest MIN_AMT not exceeding `invoice_amount` (method: 'HIGHEST_MIN_AMT_NOT_EXCEEDING_INVOICE_AMOUNT'). If no match, method='APPROVAL_CONFIG_ERROR'.
5. Implement Status Determination in Python:
   - BLOCKED: `hard_block` is true or `approval_status` is 'REJECTED'.
   - REVIEW_REQUIRED: `approval_status` is 'PENDING', human review pending, unresolved exceptions, HIGH/CRITICAL risk, unresolved matching, or insufficient evidence.
   - NOT_READY: invalid fields, missing coding, no approver found, compliance issues (vendor/bank/currency/PO), no matching evidence, or approval needed but not recorded.
   - PAY_READY: All checks pass (no blocks, fields valid, compliant, matched, low/medium risk, review/exceptions resolved, approval APPROVED).
6. Call `call_ai_llm` ONLY to generate a concise 'approval_request_summary' string based on the inputs and the Python-determined result.
7. Construct the final output JSON strictly matching the specified contract and status mappings (e.g. BLOCKED -> execution_status='BLOCK', readiness_status='BLOCKED', next_action='Route to Blocked', etc.). Ensure no terms like 'PAID', 'PAYMENT_COMPLETED', or 'PAYMENT_EXECUTED' are used.
8. Save the dictionary as `ap08_evaluation_result.json` and upload it using `upload_output_file`.

import os import httpx import pandas as pd import io import json from pydantic import BaseModel, Field from datetime import datetime # --- Step Implementation: process_readiness --- async def step_process_readiness(): # 1. Inputs with safe defaults case_id = user_inputs.get('case_id', 'UNKNOWN') # Safe float conversion raw_amount = user_inputs.get('invoice_amount') try: invoice_amount = float(raw_amount) if raw_amount is not None else 0.0 except (ValueError, TypeError): invoice_amount = 0.0 cost_centre = str(user_inputs.get('cost_centre') or '').strip() gl_code = str(user_inputs.get('gl_code') or '').strip() hard_block = bool(user_inputs.get('hard_block')) fields_valid = user_inputs.get('fields_valid') if user_inputs.get('fields_valid') is not None else True vendor_compliant = user_inputs.get('vendor_compliant') if user_inputs.get('vendor_compliant') is not None else True bank_compliant = user_inputs.get('bank_compliant') if user_inputs.get('bank_compliant') is not None else True currency_compliant = user_inputs.get('currency_compliant') if user_inputs.get('currency_compliant') is not None else True po_compliant = user_inputs.get('po_compliant') if user_inputs.get('po_compliant') is not None else True matching_status = str(user_inputs.get('matching_status') or '').upper() risk_level = str(user_inputs.get('risk_level') or '').upper() human_review_status = str(user_inputs.get('human_review_status') or '').upper() exception_status = str(user_inputs.get('exception_status') or '').upper() approval_status = str(user_inputs.get('approval_status') or '').upper() token = os.environ.get("MICROSOFT_ONEDRIVE_TOKEN") if not token: raise ValueError("MICROSOFT_ONEDRIVE_TOKEN is missing.") # 2. Download Files async def download_file(path): url = f"https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/me/drive/root:{path}:/content" async with httpx.AsyncClient(follow_redirects=True) as client: headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}"} resp = await client.get(url, headers=headers) if resp.status_code != 200: raise Exception(f"Failed to download {path}: {resp.status_code} - {resp.text}") return resp.content try: doa_content = await download_file("/AP-Invoice-Assurance/Reference/DOA_Matrix.csv") gl_content = await download_file("/AP-Invoice-Assurance/Reference/SKA1_GL_MASTER.csv") except Exception as e: print(f"Error during file download: {e}", file=sys.stderr) raise doa_df = pd.read_csv(io.BytesIO(doa_content)) gl_df = pd.read_csv(io.BytesIO(gl_content)) # 3. GL & Cost Centre Validation gl_valid = False cc_allowed = False validation_notes = [] # SAKNR is gl_code, KOSTL_ALLOWED is csv list gl_match = gl_df[gl_df['SAKNR'].astype(str) == gl_code] if not gl_match.empty: gl_valid = True allowed_ccs_raw = gl_match.iloc[0]['KOSTL_ALLOWED'] allowed_ccs = str(allowed_ccs_raw).split(',') if pd.notna(allowed_ccs_raw) else [] allowed_ccs = [c.strip() for c in allowed_ccs] if cost_centre in allowed_ccs: cc_allowed = True else: validation_notes.append(f"Cost Centre {cost_centre} not allowed for GL {gl_code}.") else: validation_notes.append(f"GL Code {gl_code} not found in master.") # 4. Approver Selection doa_filtered = doa_df[doa_df['KOSTL'].astype(str) == cost_centre].copy() approver_name = "N/A" approver_email = "N/A" selection_method = "N/A" if not doa_filtered.empty: doa_filtered['MIN_AMT'] = pd.to_numeric(doa_filtered['MIN_AMT'], errors='coerce') eligible_rows = doa_filtered[doa_filtered['MIN_AMT'] <= invoice_amount] if not eligible_rows.empty: # "Select row with the highest MIN_AMT not exceeding invoice_amount" best_row = eligible_rows.sort_values('MIN_AMT', ascending=False).iloc[0] approver_name = best_row['APPROVER'] approver_email = best_row['EMAIL'] selection_method = 'HIGHEST_MIN_AMT_NOT_EXCEEDING_INVOICE_AMOUNT' else: selection_method = 'APPROVAL_CONFIG_ERROR' validation_notes.append("No DOA range found for this amount.") else: selection_method = 'APPROVAL_CONFIG_ERROR' validation_notes.append(f"No DOA configuration found for Cost Centre {cost_centre}.") # 5. Status Determination is_blocked = hard_block or approval_status == "REJECTED" is_review_req = ( approval_status == "PENDING" or "PENDING" in human_review_status or "UNRESOLVED" in exception_status or risk_level in ["HIGH", "CRITICAL"] or "UNRESOLVED" in matching_status or "PARTIAL" in matching_status ) is_not_ready = ( not fields_valid or not gl_valid or not cc_allowed or selection_method == "APPROVAL_CONFIG_ERROR" or not vendor_compliant or not bank_compliant or not currency_compliant or not po_compliant or "FAILED" in matching_status ) if is_blocked: readiness_status = "BLOCKED" execution_status = "BLOCK" next_action = "Route to Blocked" elif is_review_req: readiness_status = "REVIEW_REQUIRED" execution_status = "REVIEW" next_action = "Route for Review" elif is_not_ready: readiness_status = "NOT_READY" execution_status = "NOT_READY" next_action = "Address Discrepancies" else: if approval_status in ["APPROVED", "NOT_REQUIRED"]: readiness_status = "PAY_READY" execution_status = "READY" next_action = "Prepare for Payment" else: readiness_status = "NOT_READY" execution_status = "NOT_READY" next_action = "Address Discrepancies" # 6. AI Summary class SummaryResponse(BaseModel): summary: str = Field(description="A concise summary of the approval and readiness status.") ai_prompt = f""" Case ID: {case_id} Amount: {invoice_amount} GL/CC: {gl_code}/{cost_centre} Validation: {", ".join(validation_notes) if validation_notes else "All valid"} Compliance Checks: Vendor={vendor_compliant}, Bank={bank_compliant}, Currency={currency_compliant}, PO={po_compliant} Risk Level: {risk_level} Matching: {matching_status} Current Approval: {approval_status} Determined Approver: {approver_name} ({approver_email}) Readiness: {readiness_status} """ ai_result = await call_ai_llm( system_prompt="Generate a concise 'approval_request_summary' string (max 2 sentences) based on the provided invoice evaluation details. Do not use markdown.", user_prompt=ai_prompt, response_schema_pydantic_model=SummaryResponse, model="gemini-3-flash-preview" ) # 7. Final JSON Construction result_dict = { "case_id": case_id, "evaluation_timestamp": datetime.now().isoformat(), "readiness_status": readiness_status, "execution_status": execution_status, "next_action": next_action, "approver_details": { "name": approver_name, "email": approver_email, "selection_method": selection_method }, "validation_summary": { "gl_valid": gl_valid, "cc_allowed": cc_allowed, "notes": validation_notes }, "approval_request_summary": ai_result.summary } # 8. Save and Upload output_path = "ap08_evaluation_result.json" import sys with open(output_path, "w") as f: json.dump(result_dict, f, indent=2) file_url = await upload_output_file(output_path) # UI Output from IPython.display import HTML, display status_badge_class = { "PAY_READY": "ag-badge-success", "REVIEW_REQUIRED": "ag-badge-warning", "NOT_READY": "ag-badge-warning", "BLOCKED": "ag-badge-error" }.get(readiness_status, "ag-badge-neutral") html_summary = f"""

Evaluation Readiness: {case_id}

{readiness_status} Next Action: {next_action}

{ai_result.summary}

Decision Breakdown

Metric Status / Value
Approver{approver_name} ({approver_email})
GL Validation{"✅ Valid" if gl_valid else "❌ Invalid"}
Cost Centre Check{"✅ Allowed" if cc_allowed else "❌ Restricted"}
Compliance{"✅ Pass" if (vendor_compliant and bank_compliant and currency_compliant and po_compliant) else "❌ Discrepancies Found"}
Risk Level{risk_level}
Download Full Result (JSON)
""" display(HTML(html_summary)) print(json.dumps(result_dict, indent=2)) import sys await step_process_readiness()
